headline_finding: No group-scope behaviour is live-proven anywhere in this repository.
was captured with exactly one character selected, and the only witnessed
context action is 'operate'. Twenty of thirty-four manifest entries are
unproven proposals. The plan's section 10.1 map is therefore a starting
classification, as it says, and not a description of known behaviour.

target_scenarios.note: Each encodes a target behaviour and fails today. Strict marking turns the suite red on XPASS, so the slice that implements a behaviour must deliberately retire its marker rather than leave a gate silently passing. All nine must be resolved, converted to an explicitly withheld-capability test, or deleted before stage closure.
